scientific_integrity: Exact two-season 2-by-2 matrix product with all-parameter polynomial sign proof; exact three-season rational counterexample. The mathematical result is limited to deterministic density-independent expected-abundance growth and is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Constant first-opportunity germination with mandatory old-seed germination and no older seed persistence.
No adult carryover, density effects, climate-responsive germination, or demographic/environmental stochasticity.
Full text of some older age-structured and correlated-yield studies was inaccessible; historical priority is provisional.
title: Period-two germination rigidity and a three-season rescue counterexample in an age-two seed bank
